<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
# Bind the default ":" prefix used for shape identifiers
@prefix : <https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes#> .

#############################
# Shape 1 – General applicability of Ice‑Class regulatory provisions (section 1.8 and chapter 2)
#############################
:IceClassRegulatoryProvisionShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:applicableIceClassRegulatoryProvision ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:in ( nltl:iceClassSection1Point8Provision2021
                nltl:iceClassDraughtChapter2Provision2021 ) ;
        sh:message "The ship must reference one of the Ice‑Class regulatory provisions applicable to all ships (section 1.8 or chapter 2)." ;
    ] .

#############################
# Shape 2 – Edition applicability (2021 Ice‑Class Regulations) for ships contracted on/after 5 July 2021
#############################
:IceClassEditionApplicabilityShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:or (
        # Case A: ships with a construction contract date **before** 2021‑07‑05 – no edition constraint
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path nltl:constructionContractDate ;
                sh:datatype xsd:date ;
                sh:maxExclusive "2021-07-05"^^xsd:date ;
                sh:message "Construction contract date is before the 2021 applicability threshold; edition constraint does not apply." ;
            ] ;
        ]
        # Case B: ships with a construction contract date **on/after** 2021‑07‑05 – must use the 2021 edition
        [
            sh:property [
                sh:path nltl:constructionContractDate ;
                sh:datatype xsd:date ;
                sh:minInclusive "2021-07-05"^^xsd:date ;
                sh:message "Construction contract date is on or after 5 July 2021; the 2021 Ice‑Class regulation edition must be applied." ;
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition ;
                sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
                sh:in ( nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2021 ) ;
                sh:message "For ships contracted on/after 5 July 2021 the applicable Ice‑Class regulation edition must be the 2021 edition." ;
            ] ;
        ]
    ) .

#############################
# Shape 3 – Data‑type enforcement for construction contract date
#############################
:ConstructionContractDateShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:constructionContractDate ;
        sh:datatype xsd:date ;
        sh:message "The construction contract date must be a valid xsd:date literal." ;
    ] .

#############################
# Shape 4 – Data‑type enforcement for applicableIceClassRegulationEdition
#############################
:ApplicableIceClassRegulationEditionShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:message "The applicable Ice‑Class regulation edition must be an IRI referencing a controlled edition individual." ;
    ] .

#############################
# Shape 5 – Data‑type enforcement for applicableIceClassRegulatoryProvision
#############################
:ApplicableIceClassRegulatoryProvisionShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:applicableIceClassRegulatoryProvision ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:message "The applicable Ice‑Class regulatory provision must be an IRI referencing a controlled provision individual." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
